- removed Foraging mod - removed Stunning pets mod - removed Hypercritical mod, functionality separated to One hit objects mod and One hit enemies mod - new One hit enemies mod: (optional) Kill everything in just one hit: monsters, minions, bosses, mechanical turrets, animals, deer. - added compressors to Bigger backpack mod, now 1 notch covers 3 materials, increasing capacity another 3x - added animal friend effect to the Stealth mod - added stars for mods for DLCs to the Options screen, and hidding mods for unpurchased DLCs
- added pets to More item slots mod, now you can have 10 pets running around
- fixed Give keys mod unicode characters not showing, by changing the list box to a drop down box
- fixed sleep speed when World time multiplier mod is used
- removed Tips mod from Cheats modpack

- fixed bug in Automatic attack mod on mobile touchscreen devices - new Ignore death counter mod: (optional) Bypass the number of deaths check when opening the sarcophage in the King's Tomb pyramid. - new Break spirits mod: (optional) Make mana spirits vulnerable by default, no need for mana-infused tools.

- added a check to Automatic attack mod to only show up on stages where you can attack - changed number of targetted monsters and objects in More targets from 90 to 900 - changed Material Magnet+ maximum radius from 4000 to 5000
- fixed display compability a tiny bit of Bigger backpack mod with CE hacks

- fixed a bug in several mods which used player modifiers was not activating for the co-op player - added a huge material magnet range for the tombs when Crack tombs mod is enabled - modified Automatic attack mod to hide the icon on Android until the Cheats are not activated - changed Speedhack mod to deactivate on tomb, dungeon and unarmed stages
- added a checkbox for Crack tombs mod to the Options menu

- added a confirmation screen to Bigger backpack mod, because users won't or can't read - added a checkbox for Beat Gembine mod to the Options menu - added an activation process to the Cheats, options are hidden until the player intentionally wants to cheat - modified the scrollbar size on some interfaces to make it more comfortable on Android

- new Bigger backpack mod: (optional) Get +24 backpack notches per material slots, increasing the backpack capacity by 300%. - new More item slots mod: (optional) Carry +2 weapons and +5 trinkets, additional slots open in your inventory. You also get +1 special after you crafted the Special Item Slot.
- fixed a bug in Level up mod, it now calculates with your xp buffs
- new Tips mod: Showing tips for the mods on the loading screens.
- moved Event Log mod to Quality of life modpack
- changed maximum value of Material magnet+ to 4000

- fixed bug in Boost refiner mod duplicating materials - fixed bug in Boost refiner mod button not showing up on Refiner screen on Android - fixed gamepad controls on Android for Boost refiner and Crack tombs mods - changed Automatic attack mod icon on Android is hidden when gamepad is used
- new Loot drop bonus mod: (optional) Extra materials dropped from objects, gatherables, mana beads. - changed Material magnet+ mod from fixed checkbox to a slider with a higher max value
- new Level up mod: (optional) Add experience points to level up your player. - changed World time multiplier mod value display to read easier - changed Hypercritical mod damage from 10x to 50x
- new World time multiplier mod: (optional) Adjust how many in-game seconds pass during a real life second. Vanilla value is 20.
- added Doomsday DLC2 overground tomb altar support to the Crack tombs mod
- removed Walk on water mod as sometimes the player clipped below the protecting cover actor into the water, and still got drown
- new Walk on water mod: (optional) Cross the lakes and seas without drowning. Use Automatic climbing mod or Rift forwards mod to climb out.
- new Infinite items mod: (optional) Replenish ammo, throwables and item uses continuously to get unlimited consumables.
- added DLC keys to Give keys mod
- fixed a bug in Crack tombs mod where it gave an interaction on non-tomb stages too
- fixed bug in Electrifying grenade mod changed the max throw distance for all throwables - changed Electrifying grenade to not use up the item if the cheat is active
- fixed bug in Rift forwards mod was hidden in the Options
- added animation and particle effects to Crack tombs mod - changed 9 mods that used recipes to use temporary modifiers, works better with other mods and coop players
- fixed a bug in Spawn materials mod when it spawned +1 material
- added in-game event logging to some of the mods to help 10tons know why strange things happened in modded save files
- new Temperature protection mod: (optional) Ignore temperature changes, both hot and cold, without equipping anything.
- new Electrifying grenade mod: (optional) Power on circuit components with the Electric Grenade to skip Doomsday DLC2 puzzles.

- new Speedhack mod: (optional) Maximize game speed to make everything happen faster. - new Stealth mod: (optional) Minimize enemy aggro distance so you can casually walk past the monsters. - fixed a bug in Power walking mod when the HUD slider stayed on screen during a cutscene
- new Light Souls mod: (optional) Keep materials in your backpack upon death. Nothing lost when you die.
- added hard blocking for incompatible mods
- added DLC3 pet dungeons to the Crack tombs mod, now you can skip pet puzzles too

- fixed bugs in Spawn materials mod when you listed multiple materials in a comma separated list - added safety checks for using DLC items with Craft recipes mod when you do not have the DLC - added safety checks for using DLC items with Spawn materials mod when you do not have the DLC
- new Give keys mod: (optional) Get any collectible keys without finding them or completing quests. - added scrollbars for the scrollable lists of Craft recipes mod and Spawn materials mod
- fixed compatibility with DLCX mod by XYB88 - fixed bugs with chinese localized labels sometimes not translating
- added support for additional materials from mods into the Spawn materials mod
- added support for comma-separated list of multiple materials in the Spawn materials mod input text box
- new Spawn materials mod: (optional) Create any material, wood, metal, crop, mushroom, fish, mana using the vanilla Cheats UI.

- new Craft recipes mod: (optional) Unlock, craft and upgrade all recipes, items, tools, weapons, specials, trinkets, outfits, headgears, features, transmitters, buildables, dishes, skills, obelisks using the vanilla Cheats UI.
- added UI rescale for Event Log mod on Mobile UI, so you can read the text on Android too - added UI rescale for Mobile UI
- new Defeat shelter hordes mod: (optional) Cheat shelter defense minigames, you auto-win the fight on activation.

- new Crack tomb puzzles mod: (optional) Cheat the tomb stage you are in, if you want. Long press the Target Lock button when near the exit. Or on mobile UI, it also shows a button on the Entryway POI on the map screen.
- new Automatic attack mod: (optional) Enable continuous attack with a custom keypress. Accessibility mod if you have repetitive strain injury or a mobility impairment.

- moved Scripting mod to Developer tools modpack under Code editor name - removed Resource visualizer mod, as i realized, it does not work without developer mode enabled, and it is already accessible with it - changed Change time mod to not allow going back in time to prevent bugging out refiners and all
- new Change time mod: Set time of the current day on a popup slider.

- new Event Log mod: Replay the path you walked from the start with the vanilla Game Event Log on the Collection tab. - new Scripting mod: Execute scripts with the help of a built-in code editor and documentation of the vanilla game. - added package box icon to distinguish modded tools, buttons, interactions - added another button to access the Change Log from the Options screen
- changed Resource visualizer mod button placement
- new Resource visualizer mod: View all materials, recipes of the stage on a map with the vanilla Resource Visualizer on the Collection tab.
- added collapsible groupings to the Options page for the mods
- new Free wells mod: (optional) Make your wishes come true for free at the Wishing Wells, you don't have to pay.
- modified Material magnet+ radius from +9000% to +900% - modified Hypercritical damage from +5000% to +900%
- added alternate method to trigger Boost refiner mod on mobile UI
- added mobile UI to the Change Log, and removed vanilla block on all platforms, so you can see the changes on Android too
- mod change logs are listed on the Change Log page accessible from the main menu
- new Sleep anytime mod: (optional) Remove sleep limitation, you don't have to wait hours between sleeps.
- updated to use Steam Workshop load priority system in v1.4.0.32

- modified Plenty of fish mod to be compatible with DarthNemesis's Fishing Shovel mod - modified Power walking mod to reset walk speed when entering tombs and dungeons - modified Rift forwards mod to move slower in tombs and dungeons - changed Rift forwards mod cursor to be more visible - changed Speed fishing mod to be even faster
- updated to game version 1.4.0.29 - updated to be compatible with Steam Workshop - new More melee targets mod - uploaded to Steam Workshop
- changed tooltips and youtube links to a nice popup

- fixed a bug in Predator mod from Quality of life modpack - fixed a bug in Camera heading mod from Quality of life modpack - fixed the lag spike in Automatic material transporter mod, will work in v1.4 only - added teleport destination cursor for Rift forwards mod - added checks for mobile user interfaces
- increased compatibility with other modders
- added save file flagging to help 10tons with debugging save files sent with bug reports
- fixed Plenty of fish mod to complete the POI
- merged Demigod mod with God mod into one, less potent middle ground
- fixed Beat Gembine mod UI
- new Plenty of fish mod - new Beat Gembine mod
- added HUD UI button for Automatic material transporter mod
- new No fall damage mod - added links to demo videos for the mods on the Options page
- new Automatic climbing mod - new Demigod mode mod
- fixing Boost refiner interaction appeared even when it was disabled - changed some tooltips for the Mods Options UI page
- added HUD UI slider for Power walking mod - changed base Rift forwards distance a little shorter
- new Disable killzones mod
- removed Bullet time mod and moved it to Quality of life modpack
- new Speed fishing mod - changed Instant farming to be even faster - changed critical hit damage to 4000 in Hypercritical mod, as it was not enough

- new Stunning pets mod - new Foraging mod - removed damage evading from God mode mod, as it is not needed - changed critical hit damage to only 900 in Hypercritical mod, as it is enough - removed strafe modifier from Power walking mod
- modified Power walking mod from a fixed 2x recipe to dynamic 1x-10x slider - modified Bullet time mod to support coop

- added Automatic material transporter mod - added Boost refiner mod - added Bullet time mod - added Faster melee mod - added Fertilizer mod - added God mode mod - added Hypercritical mod - added Instant farming mod - added Material magnet+ mod - added Power walking mod - added Rift forwards mod - added Safer chasms mod - added Well prepared mod
